messages:
mira: AcmeHealth asked for a short demo that ties a latency spike to a model rollout + per-route cost. Can we scope a narrow, shippable plan for end-of-quarter?

leo: propose 2-track MVP: (A) add model_version to billing export + a tiny per-route cost heatmap, (B) adaptive tracing: ramp sampling when error or p95 crosses thresholds.

abby: adaptive idea: baseline 0.02 -> ramp to 0.5 for triggered routes, with tenant caps. Need exporter rate limits.

pranav: agree, implement exporter cap and proportional scaling. Also require canary with synthetic spike.

sam: UI: add a "force-capture" button for support to bump sampling for 30m. Very low-effort, high value for demos.

mira: acceptance for demo: (1) billing CSV includes model_version for top routes, (2) heatmap shows cost by model_version, (3) we can reproduce a spike in sandbox and capture >=50 traces, (4) support can trigger capture.

leo: rough estimates: billing change 1.5 dev-weeks + small backfill; heatmap 3 dev-days.

abby: tracing + caps ~2.5 dev-weeks. UI trigger ~2 dev-days.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature/obs-mini-export -> staging at 2025-06-19T11:22:05Z

pranav: gating metrics: dropped-span-rate <1%, storage growth <10% in canary. We'll simulate 50 tenants.

sam: I'll prepare synthetic traffic + README for "demo data" flags.

mira: action owners / dates:
- leo: billing tag + sample CSV (owner) - due 2025-06-27
- abby: adaptive sampling + caps (owner) - due 2025-07-08
- sam: support trigger + demo traffic (owner) - due 2025-07-01
- pranav: exporter rate-limiter + canary tests (owner) - due 2025-07-03

leo: opening RFC for schema change today.

abby: config prototype we discussed:
```
adaptive:
  baseline: 0.02
  trigger_metric: p95_latency_ms
  threshold: 150
  ramp_to: 0.5
  tenant_cap: 0.3
```

mira: privacy note: redact prompt text by default. Enterprise opt-in for full traces. Add to runbook.

ops-bot: reminder: observability-standup tomorrow 10:00

mira: thanks all. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own your item. We'll keep demo scope tight.
